timestamp.description: Firestore Timestamp; serialised as RFC 3339 in the API

category.description: Mekasa category vocabulary (Produce, Dairy, Pantry, Meat, Frozen, Beverages, Household, Other, ...)

storeChainId.description: References catalog table store_chains.chain_id (Cloud SQL, ADR-008); same shape as its CHECK constraint

productId.description: Opaque key into catalog table products.product_id (Cloud SQL, ADR-008). Product enums (source, status) are CHECK constraints in backend/catalog/migrations/0001_catalog.sql
